description: This file contains Data Access Object (DAO) interfaces for interacting with the database tables related to calendar events, leaves, and astrology details. It defines methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records in these tables.

classes.name: CalendarEventDao
classes.description: DAO interface for accessing calendar events data.

classes.name: LeaveDao
classes.description: DAO interface for managing leave records.

classes.name: AstrologyDao
classes.description: DAO interface for astrology details data.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all calendar events as a flow of list.

methods.name: getEventsForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events within a specified date range.

methods.name: getEventsModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertEvent
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a calendar event.

methods.name: getAllLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves all leave records ordered by date.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves leave records within a date range.

methods.name: getLeavesModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves leave records modified after a given timestamp.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a leave record.

methods.name: getAstrologyForDate
methods.description: Retrieves astrology details for a specific date.

methods.name: getAstrologyModifiedAfter
methods.description: Retrieves astrology records modified after a timestamp.
